name: Wall Kick
description: Hold the pool wall with both hands, arms straight, face in the water and body long behind you, and flutter kick in place. With no travel and no breathing to manage, all the attention goes to the kick itself: started at the hip, knees nearly straight, ankles loose, feet no more than about a foot apart. Turn the head to breathe whenever needed. The standard way to learn a hip-driven kick before asking it to move you.
